description: Report what is actually at a coordinate, without you having to guess first. Education has no command to read a block, so this runs testforblock with air as a sentinel; when the guess is wrong, the game message names the actual block. Note: it returns the **localized display name** (for example "Dirt", or "泥土" in a Chinese game), not the block ID (dirt), so it cannot be fed back to mc_set_block; to check by ID, use mc_test_block. The message format has no official guarantee; when it cannot be parsed, this tool returns an error with the raw message instead of guessing.

mode.description: absolute = world coordinates; relative = ~ relative to the command source; local = ^ relative to its facing

name: mc_read_block

block.description: Localized display name; when it cannot be parsed, this tool returns an error instead of null

title: Read which block is at a coordinate
